heading: SYVS Subscription Editor
description: Manage and edit VMESS and SS share links. Easily add, edit, and reorder links, then generate subscription links for each group.
key_help: The key is stored as an MD5 hash. You can reset it on this page if you forget it.
dont_save_plaintext: Do not store the password in plaintext
key_warning: When enabled, the key will not be stored in plaintext in the database. When disabled, it will be stored in plaintext.
key_warning_lost: If you forget the key, you will no longer be able to use it to access subscription links. The subscription links will also disappear after you refresh this page. Choose carefully.
group_invalid: The group name cannot be empty or duplicate another group name.
reset_password_description: Reset the password used to access the editor. Make sure it is sufficiently complex.
copy_failed: Copy failed. Please copy the link manually.
new_key_generated: A new key has been generated
load_failed: Failed to load data. Refresh the page and try again.
save_key_network_failed: Network error. Failed to save the key.
key_saved: The new key was saved successfully
save_groups_network_failed: Network error. Failed to save the groups.
unsaved_changes: You have unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to leave this page?
tour_welcome_description: Welcome to the SYVS subscription editor! We will guide you through the initial setup.
tour_password_description: For security, set a new password for the editor page.
tour_key_description: Click this button, or simply continue to the next step, to generate a new share key.
tour_new_key_description: We generated a new key for you. You can review it here.
tour_save_description: Click this button to save your share key, or continue and we will save it for you.
tour_groups_description: Add, delete, and edit groups here. You can create as many groups as you need.
tour_content_description: Add, delete, and edit links in the currently selected group here.
tour_share_description: Click the subscription share link to copy it. The link changes when you rename and save its group.
tour_mode_description: Switch to bulk import mode to paste multiple Vmess or Vless links at once.
tour_changes_description: Remember to save your groups and links after making changes. You can reload the stored data before saving.
tour_done_description: Initial setup is complete. You can now start using the SYVS subscription editor!
